bootcamp.spatial_reference: 2 * mean(|R|^2), computed from the raw experimental pair vectors in the notebook
bootcamp.spatial_reference_caveat: The notebook subtracts localization noise from the MSD but does not subtract it from its spatial second-moment proxy. Both raw and noise-corrected moments are retained in our derived references; the matched-model analysis must declare which convention it uses.
bootcamp.mapping_status: Source-model-specific notebook value only, not applicable to Chromatin Studio time units without a matched fit.

our_processing.estimator: All valid measured exact-frame-lag displacement pairs, pooled by count. Full relative-vector squared displacement, not distance-change MSD or half-relative MSD.
our_processing.missing_frames: Missing source frames remain missing; no interpolation.
our_processing.duplicates: Last row for an identical trajectory/frame, verified numerically against author H5; one RAD21 untreated, one RAD21 2h, five WAPL untreated rows.
our_processing.uncertainty: 1000 available-acquisition-cluster bootstrap resamples; WAPL6h trajectory bootstrap only because movie metadata is absent; not claimed independent biological replication.
our_processing.baseline_selection: 424 trajectories in74movie-index groups for fitting;113trajectories in18groups held out; all other conditions remain validation only.
